```{r setup, include=FALSE, message=FALSE,warning=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)
```

The full simulation results table is available on GitHub. Here we read 
this dataframe into R and use `xtable()` to print it as a latex table.

```{r}
results <- read.table("https://raw.githubusercontent.com/SFUStatgen/logF_CLR/refs/heads/main/simres.txt",header=TRUE)
names(results)[2] <- "nCon" # replace ConCaseRatio with something shorter
```

```{r}
library(xtable)

tab <- xtable(
  results,
  caption = "Complete simulation results.",
  label = "tab:complete-results",
  digits = c(rep(0,5),1,0,rep(4,9)),
  align = c("l", rep("r",ncol(results)))
)

print(
  tab,
  include.rownames = FALSE,
  tabular.environment = "longtable",
  floating = FALSE,
  booktabs = TRUE,
  size = "scriptsize",
  sanitize.text.function = identity,
  file = "simresComplete.tex"
)
```
